title: Bitwise Basics
prompt:
Write four bitwise utility functions in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `set_bit(n, pos)` -- sets the bit at position `pos` (0-indexed from the right) and returns the new value
2. `clear_bit(n, pos)` -- clears the bit at position `pos` and returns the new value
3. `toggle_bit(n, pos)` -- toggles the bit at position `pos` and returns the new value
4. `check_bit(n, pos)` -- returns `True` if the bit at position `pos` is set, `False` otherwise

**Examples:**
```python
set_bit(0, 3)       # 8  (binary 1000)
clear_bit(15, 1)    # 13 (binary 1101)
toggle_bit(5, 1)    # 7  (binary 111)
check_bit(5, 2)     # True
check_bit(5, 1)     # False
```
hints: 1 << pos creates a mask with only the bit at position pos set
OR (|) sets bits, AND (&) tests bits, XOR (^) toggles
~mask inverts all bits (used with AND to clear a specific bit)
